Write a brief academic-style statement distinguishing a legal boundary on a map from the way residents describe their neighborhood. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: While official cartography defines rigid legal boundaries for administrative governance, residents conceive of their neighborhoods through subjective, fluid mental maps shaped by daily social interactions and shared cultural landmarks.
